_why: Fixture assertions for the record index. Each one is a pair of runs whose relationship we already know, so the index can be checked without spending a model call. Study-specific by nature: it names this study's own runs, so it lives here and not in tools/.

assertions.why: Two harness files that differ only in row order. Mounting canonicalizes the tool table, so the subject received byte-identical context. The index must collapse them.
The harness file bytes differ, so provenance must stay distinct even though the stimulus is identical. This is what makes 'conditions are replaceable' checkable.
The two arms of the first cue probe. Same harness file, same task, different workspace name. The delivered context differs because the host puts the cwd in an injected message.
